findings.desc: Pipeline sequences reviewer lanes before verification evidence generation/refresh while assigning coverage verification to validate and the coverage reviewer. Evidence: plan lines around Step Contract Matrix rows for reviewer/evidence and End-To-End Flow show reviewer batch before evidence generation. This can let test-coverage review pass before final material-bound evidence exists, or require an unstated second review loop. Fix by moving evidence generation/refresh before reviewer batch, or explicitly split lanes so coverage/delivery review runs only after final evidence is material-bound.
findings.resolvedReason: Moved verification evidence generation/refresh before final reviewer lane orchestration in the Step Contract Matrix, Pipeline Stages, End-To-End Flow, text flowchart, Mermaid source, and SVG. Added evidence snapshot/stale-pass rules so coverage reviewers cannot pass before material-bound evidence exists. Verified with rg for evidence-before-review and coverage reviewer language.

findings.desc: SVG compresses smoke/transcript/delivery context and jumps toward done_prepare PASS without an explicit delivery-review or delivery-check decision. Markdown preserves the gate, so this is advisory, but the image should show delivery reviewer pass/fail to avoid implying a weaker DONE path.
findings.resolvedReason: Updated SVG flowchart to explicitly state Delivery check fail stops and After delivery PASS delegate readiness to lattice done_prepare; this makes the visual path preserve delivery review before done_prepare.

findings.desc: Metadata-only waiver policy is left open. The plan says transcript/user-value proof may be waived for explicit metadata-only stories, but Track E/F implementers still need a concrete command, schema, and owner before implementing fail-closed behavior. Advisory for current execution-plan doc.
findings.resolvedReason: Added Metadata-Only Waiver Policy with required waiver shape, eligible story types, delivery reviewer acceptance rule, and Authority/local claim boundary. Removed the corresponding open question.

findings.desc: Rendered SVG has visual ambiguity/overlap around PLAN skeleton and DEV implementation boxes. Markdown text flow and Mermaid source remain readable, so this does not block implementation, but the image should be cleaned up for a strict execution-plan artifact.
findings.resolvedReason: Adjusted SVG DEV implementation box x/width to remove overlap with PLAN skeleton box and updated SVG labels to improve readability. XML validation passes with xmllint.

findings.desc: CHK-002 edge evidence only runs xmllint --noout for the SVG. That proves XML validity but not the intent that the SVG visually distinguishes ordinary preflight from TEST-to-DONE done_prepare delegation. The SVG contains relevant nodes, but the recorded evidence command does not assert them, so semantic coverage for CHK-002 edge is missing.
findings.resolvedReason: Replaced CHK-002 edge evidence with semantic SVG grep plus xmllint: it now asserts evidence-before-review, delivery check fail stop, delivery PASS before done_prepare, and done_prepare PASS labels.

findings.desc: Several recorded rg evidence commands are not cleanly replayable because Markdown backticks inside double-quoted shell patterns can trigger command substitution in zsh, producing command-not-found stderr while rg still exits 0. Gate evidence should be deterministic and stderr-clean; replace affected evidence commands with single-quoted patterns or split rg checks that avoid backtick substitution.
findings.resolvedReason: Replaced all affected recorded rg evidence commands with single-quoted patterns or patterns that avoid Markdown backtick command substitution. Replayed the commands cleanly before recording the evidence batch.

findings.desc: Reordered evidence/reviewer sequence remains ambiguous: End-To-End Flow launches reviewers before validation, transcript diff, and delivery review, while reviewer rules say coverage/delivery-adjacent lanes become stale if validation, transcript, or delivery context is written after their pass. Flowcharts also proceed from reviewer batch to smoke/transcript/delivery without an explicit rerun/rebind path. Fix by placing validation, transcript, and delivery context before final coverage/delivery-adjacent reviewer pass, or explicitly route changed artifacts back to affected lane reruns before preflight/DONE.
findings.resolvedReason: Reworked the flow to evidence -> validation/transcript/delivery context -> final reviewer lanes -> preflight -> done_prepare. Updated Step Contract Matrix, End-To-End Flow, ASCII/Mermaid flowcharts, and SVG. Verification commands confirm validation/transcript/context and final reviewer lanes are explicit before preflight/done_prepare.

findings.desc: Pipeline Stages section still orders reviewer orchestration and preflight before live smoke/transcript and delivery context sections. This contradicts the required final sequence: evidence -> validation/transcript/delivery context -> final reviewer lanes -> preflight -> done_prepare. Fix by reordering the Pipeline Stages sections to match the matrix and end-to-end flow.
findings.resolvedReason: Reordered Pipeline Stages sections to match the final sequence: evidence, validation/transcript/delivery context, final reviewer lanes, preflight, done_prepare. Verified section headings with rg.

findings.desc: Mermaid source still routes Delivery reviewer after REVIEW / TEST preflight and then to done_prepare, creating a contradictory post-preflight delivery step instead of treating delivery as part of final material-bound context before preflight.
findings.resolvedReason: Updated Mermaid source to remove post-preflight Delivery reviewer node. Delivery context and delivery review are now represented before final preflight; preflight flows directly to target-DONE decision and done_prepare.

findings.desc: Pipeline Stages still lists reviewer orchestration before live smoke and delivery check, contradicting the updated matrix/flow where validation/transcript/delivery context must happen before final reviewers. Fix the section ordering and headings so implementers do not follow the stale order.
findings.resolvedReason: Reordered Pipeline Stages so reviewer orchestration no longer appears before live smoke/transcript and delivery context. Stage 3 now prepares validation/transcript/context; Stage 4 runs final reviewers.

findings.desc: Mermaid labels Delivery reviewer as step 6 and done_prepare as step 6, reintroducing sequence ambiguity for Mermaid-rendered readers. Fix Mermaid to match the matrix/SVG: delivery context and reviewer pass happen before REVIEW/TEST preflight, and step 6 is only done_prepare delegation.
findings.resolvedReason: Removed the Mermaid Delivery reviewer step 6 ambiguity; Mermaid now has step 6 only as done_prepare delegation after REVIEW/TEST preflight.

findings.desc: P4/Track C reviewer orchestration depends only on P1/P3, but final reviewer lanes require current transcript and delivery-context artifacts from P5/P6 before passing. Fix the dependency plan so final reviewer orchestration depends on P3 evidence snapshot plus P5/P6 artifact/context contracts.
findings.resolvedReason: Updated Track C/P4 dependencies: final coverage and delivery-adjacent reviewer gates now depend on Track D evidence snapshot, Track E transcript artifacts, and Track F delivery-context artifacts. Suggested story breakdown lists P4 depends on P1, P3, P5, and P6 for final reviewer semantics.

findings.desc: Mermaid source labels Delivery reviewer as step 6 while the Step Contract Matrix defines Step 6 as TEST-to-DONE readiness delegation and the SVG keeps delivery inside preflight/delivery check before done_prepare. This breaks markdown/SVG agreement and can mislead implementers about stage ownership.
findings.resolvedReason: Aligned Mermaid with the Step Contract Matrix and SVG: delivery is part of artifact/context and final reviewer stages before preflight; Step 6 is only TEST-to-DONE done_prepare delegation.
